mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.NICKNAME, U.EMAIL, U.USER_PHONE, U.GRADE_ID, G.GRADE_NAME, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImgUrl FROM USER U LEFT JOIN USER_GRADE G ON U.GRADE_ID = G.GRADE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_COUPON WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USED_YN = 'N' AND EXPIRE_DT BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)

SELECT HISTORY_ID, USER_ID, DESCRIPTION, AMOUNT, TYPE, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, BALANCE_AFTER AS balanceAfter FROM point_history WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, HISTORY_ID DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REVIEW_ID DESC LIMIT ${pageSize} OFFSET ${offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT T.ROOM_ID AS roomId, T.USER_ID AS userId, ( SELECT CH.MESSAGE FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY CH WHERE CH.ROOM_ID = T.ROOM_ID AND CH.USER_ID = T.USER_ID AND CH.ROLE = 'user' ORDER BY CH.REG_DATE ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS title, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(T.REG_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastRegDate FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY T WHERE T.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY T.ROOM_ID, T.USER_ID ORDER BY MAX(T.REG_DATE) DESC

SELECT UC.USER_COUPON_ID AS userCouponId, UC.USER_ID AS userId, UC.COUPON_ID AS couponId, DATE_FORMAT(UC.ISSUED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS issuedAt, DATE_FORMAT(UC.EXPIRED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiredAt, UC.USED_YN AS usedYn, DATE_FORMAT(UC.USED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS usedAt, UC.ORDER_ID AS orderId, UC.STATUS AS status, DATE_FORMAT(UC.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(UC.UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt,
C.COUPON_NAME AS couponName, C.COUPON_TYPE AS discountType, C.DISCOUNT_AMT AS discountValue FROM USER_COUPON UC INNER JOIN COUPON C ON UC.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE UC.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN UC.STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 WHEN UC.STATUS = 'USED' THEN 2 WHEN UC.STATUS = 'EXPIRED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, UC.EXPIRED_AT ASC, UC.USER_COUPON_ID DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT UC.USER_COUPON_ID AS userCouponId, UC.USER_ID AS userId, UC.COUPON_ID AS couponId, DATE_FORMAT(UC.ISSUED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS issuedAt, DATE_FORMAT(UC.EXPIRED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiredAt, UC.STATUS AS status,
C.COUPON_NAME AS couponName, C.COUPON_TYPE AS discountType, C.DISCOUNT_AMT AS discountValue FROM USER_COUPON UC INNER JOIN COUPON C ON UC.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE UC.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY UC.USER_COUPON_ID DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.BOARD_ID AS boardId, b.TITLE AS title, b.CONTENT AS content, b.CATEGORY AS category, b.USER_ID AS userId,
u.USER_NAME AS userName, u.NICKNAME AS nickName,
DATE_FORMAT(b.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt,
b.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, b.LIKE_COUNT AS likeCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT bc WHERE bc.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID AND bc.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) AS commentCount,
( SELECT bi.IMG_URL FROM BOARD_IMG bi WHERE bi.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID ORDER BY bi.SORT_ORDER ASC, bi.IMG_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbImgUrl
FROM BOARD_BOOKMARK bb JOIN BOARD b ON bb.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN USER u ON b.USER_ID = u.USER_ID
WHERE bb.USER_ID = #{userId} AND b.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY bb.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, -- ★ 추가 U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS boardCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS commentCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(LIKE_COUNT), 0) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS likeCount, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') >= 100 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(LIKE_COUNT),0) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') >= 500 THEN 'MODAK' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') >= 50 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(LIKE_COUNT),0) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') >= 200 THEN 'FIRE_CAMPER' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') >= 20 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(LIKE_COUNT),0) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') >= 50 THEN 'CAMPER' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') >= 5 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') >= 10 THEN 'EMBER' ELSE 'SPROUT' END AS communityGrade FROM USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}
